Commentary.Commentary: The Bangladesh players are all smiles as they pose with the trophy. That's it from us. We hope we kept you fans in India awake and engaged throughout the series. These two sides now face-off in a three-match T20I series which begins on the 1st of August at the same venue at 0830 local (1230 GMT) before they head to Florida for the remaining two games. Join in for those games. Till then, goodbye and take care.
Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza, says cricket is a mental game. Adds they were very professional today. Ends by saying the boys are in good touch and they are looking forward to the T20I series.

Man of the Match and Series, Tamim Iqbal, says they did not have a great Test series. Further adds he has practiced hard and it has come off well. Admits he always tries batting long and it worked out. Ends by saying the wickets were not easy here and patience was the key.

Windies skipper, Jason Holder, says they struggled to put together a complete game. He felt 300 was a par score here and also, their bowlers were not up to the mark today. He admits they lost momentum in the middle. Credits the way Gayle played at the start and how Powell played towards the end. Congratulates Bangladesh for their win and says they were excellent throughout. Ends by saying they still have a lot to learn but they take a lot of positives from this series.

Bangladesh were not at their best at the start with the ball. They leaked quite a few runs and even on the field. Skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza, was the pick of the bowlers, finishing with two wickets. He along with Mehidy Hasan bowled excellent lengths and didn't allow the Windies batsmen to get hold of them. Mustafizur Rahman was handy in his initial spell but went for plenty towards the end. Shakib too did the job with the ball but didn't have wickets to show for it. In the end, it was an all-round performance from the Bangla Tigers which helped them clinch the series.

Chasing anything above 300, you always need a good start and the openers provided exactly that. Chris Gayle and Evin Lewis got Windies off to a very good one. The former missed out on his ton but laid the foundation for others to chase down the target. There will be a few questions about the batting of Shai Hope as he never took off. He had two 50-plus stands with Chris Gayle and Shimron Hetmyer but not at the best of rates. The hosts then lost a couple of wickets and when everything seemed lost, Rovman Powell powered his way to a quickfire fifty. He kept the flag waving for a brief time but didn't get enough support from the other end.

Bangladesh win the match and take the series 2-1. What a performance from the visitors. Shakib Al Hasan did mention they perform better in the limited-over format and they did exactly that. They could have sealed the series in the second match itself but they have done it today.
A dot to end! A forward defense I should write. On a length around off, kept out. Mortaza pumps his fist in joy, hugs all around, smiles in the dressing room as BANGLADESH WIN BY 18 RUNS!
Shorter in length by Mustafizur. Powell tucks it around the corner for a run.

Brilliant stop by Rubel! He bowled a brilliant last over and is now contributing in the field as well. A short ball outside off, Nurse cuts it towards point. Rubel there dives to his right and makes a half stop. A run taken.
A dot! So that should surely be it unless the Fizz bowls a no ball or a wide. An off pace delivery on middle, Nurse swings blindly and he misses.
Only a single! Is that the game for the visitors? One would feel so. A good change in length, a short ball on middle, Powell pulls it towards deep square leg but only a single results. 21 in 4 now.
SIX! There is one of them! 4 more needed! Right in the arc. Full and on middle, Powell swings, he connects and when he hits it, it stays hit. Flies over the mid-wicket fence.

Take a bow Hossain! He has bowled brilliantly in this penultimate over. Another yorker on middle and off, Powell can only get an inside edge to short fine leg. They take a run. 28 needed from the last over. Where is Carlos Brathwaite?
Pinpoint yorker. This over I think has won it for the visitors. Serves a yorker on leg, hit to mid on for one. 5 singles from 5 balls. Gold dust.

Good stop! Saves a certain boundary for his side and it is an excellent over till now. Full ball outside off, Powell gets an inside edge towards the keeper who dives to his left and stops it with one hand. Single taken.
Yorker on off, cut to covers. They quickly change ends.
Misses his yorker and dishes out a low full toss on leg, Powell swings and gives it on the bounce to long on. Just one more.
Full and around off, Nurse gets on one knee and slices it with some force along the turf to extra cover. Will get just one for it.

Bangladesh had the game there! Had Mushfiqur hit, Powell was a dead duck. Nevertheless, the Fizz ends with a dot and only 6 comes from this over. Another slower ball on middle, Powell misses the flick to get hit on the pads. The players appeal as the batsman sets off for a run. The umpire shakes his head and in the meantime Nurse sends Powell back. He turns to get in but to his fortune, Rahim misses. 34 in the last two.
Another brilliant delivery. The off pace ball on leg stump, Ashley Nurse is way too early into the scoop. It hits the bottom portion of the bat and goes towards point for a run.
Powell makes room and the Fizz follows him. All Powell can do is tuck it through square leg for a run. 5 from the 4 balls bowled, the game is slipping away from the Windies.

FOUR! Unlucky for the bowler but the Windies won't mind. They won't mind how they come as long as they come. Another cutter on middle, this one pitches and then turns away. Powell tries to clear the leg side but gets an outside edge, past the short third man fielder and into the fence. Need a few more of these.
Fuller on the stumps, not giving room to Powell. He hits it back to the bowler. So a wicket and a dot to begin the 18th over.
Ashley Nurse is the new man in.

OUT! In the air... and taken! Mustafizur strikes and this should make him feel a lot better. He had gone for 29 in his last two and he strikes off his very first ball of his new spell. The off cutter on off, this one angles across the batsman. Holder tries to go downtown but the ball goes off the outer half towards long off. Rubel there makes no mistake this time.
Mustafizur Rahman to bowl his 9th over.
A single to end the over! 11 from it! 40 needed from 3 overs. Holder hits it through mid-wicket for a run.
WIDE! Shakib bowls it way outside off, expecting the batsman to step out. He does not and a wide signaled.
Again right off the middle but straight to the man at deep mid-wicket. Fuller in length on middle, Powell hits it to Sabbir for a run.

FOUR! NO! Excellent effort from Sabbir in the deep. This one is slightly short and Powell picks the length early. He pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Sabbir there runs to his right, dives and seems to push it back in. The batsmen run two and the umpire goes upstairs to check. Replays roll in and it shows he has done well. Every run is important at this stage and Sabbir has saved two there.
FOUR! And Powell has delivered! A quicker one on middle, Powell swings hard and connects well. The ball in a blink of an eye reaches the mid-wicket fence.
Very full again by Shakib, Holder hits it down towards long on for a run. Shakib too starts his over well. A boundary needed.
Shakib fires this full on the pads, Powell tries to flick but gets it off the inner half towards short fine leg for a run.
Shakib Al Hasan to complete his quota of overs.

Make that six as Powell brings up his fifty with a single. It has come off just 27 balls and it is because of him the Windies are in the balance. However, his job is yet not done. He eases this down to long on and gets to the other end. That also ends the spell of Mortaza. He was excellent at the start and has finished off even better. Just 11 from his last two and his figures read 10-0-63-2.

In the air... but on the bounce. Another off pace delivery outside off, Holder tries to clear the fence but gets it off the inner half towards deep mid-wicket. Shakib collects it on the bounce and a single results. Just 5 from the over till now.
Brilliant stuff from the Bangladesh skipper. He is giving the batsman no pace to work with and the length is also excellent. Powell whips it down to long on for another single.
Sticking to the slower ball and they are working for him. Holder can only clip it towards deep square leg for a run.
Slower ball on middle, Powell tucks it around the corner. He wanted two but has to settle with a single. Once again Mortaza has started his over well.
Holder does the right thing by hitting it down towards long and giving the strike over to Powell who is hitting them clean and long.

SIX! BANG! A maximum to start the over and a maximum to end it. 16 from this one, just the over the Windies needed. Mustafizur misses the yorker by an inch. Powell says thank you so much and lofts it over long on. He moves onto 47 and the Windies need another 57 from 30.
Goes very full again outside off, Holder cannot get under it and he just hits it through covers for a run.
Lovely from Fizz. This is what he is known for. Another yorker outside off, Powell tries to jam it out but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg. Only a single.
Full and outside off, Holder squeezes it out towards point and the batsmen complete a run.
Excellent comeback! A yorker outside off, Powell swings but gets an inside edge onto his pads and the batsmen run a single. 7 from 2.

SIX! BOOM! Powell is taking the Fizz to the cleaners here. A gift, a full toss but it still has to be put away and Powell does it in style. He sends it sailing over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Bowler under pressure now.
Oh yes! Another cutter, this one stays a touch low. Powell works it down to long on for a run. 73 needed in 36.
Just 4 from the 5 balls bowled as Holder pushes it towards covers. Can the skipper finish it well?
Another single as Powell works it down to long on.
Holder eases this down to mid on for a run. So the first half of this over has belonged to the visitors.
Slower delivery again on middle, Powell works it around the corner and a single results.
Jason Holder is the new man in.

OUT! Hope holes out! His struggle in the middle comes to an end and this could probably work in the favor of the Windies. A slower ball by Mortaza on middle, Hope flicks it uppishly towards Shakib at deep mid-wicket. He comes in a few steps and accepts it.
FOUR! He does finish it on a high note. Muscles this slower ball straight down the ground for a boundary. That was a boundary as soon as it left the bat. 78 needed of the last 7 overs.
Wide! Full and wide outside off, Powell misses it but the umpire signals a wide.
SIX! Boom! Clean! Picks up the slower ball and hoicks it over mid-wicket for half a dozen. Can Powell end it on a high note?
This time the third man was finer and hence they get just a run.
Moves across the off pole and looks to paddle it to the off side but once again cannot find the desired the connection. Just a run off the 3 balls.
Angles this across Hope who fails to connect with the ball.
Slower ball outside off, Powell looks to hit it to the on side but gets a leading edge to the off side. It lands safe and the batsmen cross.
Lofts this ball over mid on for just one. 9 off the over. 18 from the last two. Windies needed to step on the gas now.
Inside edge but it does not go fine enough. Powell throws his bat at this and gets an inside edge. The fielder at short fine leg chases it and keeps it to two.
Length ball on the pads, Powell flicks it in the gap for a couple of runs. Still a very good over from the visitors.
Flicks this off his pads for one.

Awkward bounce and they will pick up the extra run. Length ball outside off, Hope punches it off the front foot towards extra cover. Shakib couldn't collect it properly and the ball rolls past him. A brace results.
99 more needed form 53 balls. Powell flat bats this down the ground to long on for a run.
Excellent stuff from Rahman. Leg cutter outside off, Hope connects with thin air. A good over for the Windies, 9 from it. It is still below the required rate though.
FOUR! 200 up for the home side. Hope picks his spot and flicks this over the head of short fine leg fielder for a boundary. They need this every over from here.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.

FOUR! Bad field placement and not the best captaincy. With the Fizz angling the ball across the batsman, the third man should be a little finer which he is not. He bowls a cutter outside off, Powell swings and gets a fat outside edge to the third man region. Boundary.
Another cutter and Powell can't do anything about it. Reaches for the ball but cannot make contact.
Cutter outside off, cut to the man at point. The Fizz has just given away 10 runs in his five overs.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. 5 fielders can now stand outside the circle. Meanwhile, Mustafizur Rahman to bowl.
The batsman defends it from within the crease. They pick up a single.

Another drop! But a very tough chance. A good effort in the end by Hasan. A short ball on middle, Powell powers his pull shot towards mid-wicket. Hasan there leaps and stretches both his hands up but the ball bursts through and the batsmen run two.
Slower ball on off, Powell defends it towards covers. Hope wants a run but is rightly sent back by his partner.
Good length on middle, Powell tries to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Eases this through covers for a run.
Good length on off, Hope times it nicely through covers. The fielder in the deep runs to his right, dives and saves two runs for his side.
Mashrafe Mortaza is back on.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary for the hosts. They will need a lot more of these. Slower ball on middle and leg, Powell throws the kitchen sink at it and lofts it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Stays back in the crease and punches it through cover for one.
Powell has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Flicks this through the vacant mid-wicket region for an easy run.
Dot balls adding up. Tries to cut this one past short third man but fails to do so.
Quicker one outside off, Hope goes low to cut it but cannot make contact.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single. Just 4 from this over, another tight one from Mehidy and that ends his spell. He finishes with brilliant figures of 10-0-45-1.
Rovman Powell replaces Kieran Powell.

RUN OUT! No it is not going to be his day as his luck runs out. Horrible misunderstanding there. Hope cuts this towards the man at covers, Mashrafe Mortaza. Both the batsmen go for a run but seeing the fielder pick the ball up cleanly, Hope refuses. Powell is at the point of no return and Mortaza lobs it towards the bowler who whips the bails off. Powell is now walking back and the Windies are now staring down the barrel.
Shortens his length a touch on middle, this one turns back in. Hope tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.

Run out chance but not taken! Is it going to Powell's day? A catch dropped earlier in the over and then this run out chance. This is flicked towards Mortaza at mid-wicket. Kieran goes for the single. Mashrafe has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Had he hit, Powell was a goner.

Fifty for Hope, not at the ideal pace he would have liked but nevertheless he is still out there. Now it is time for him to up the ante and stay there till the end. He works this through mid-wicket for a run to get to that milestone.

DROPPED! But take nothing away from that effort. Sabbir did all the hard work there as this ball was chipped towards him at long on. He came running in and then put in the dive. Got two hands to it but fails to hang on. The batsmen take a run. How costly will this prove?
A dot! So it remains only three from the over. Quicker on off, Hope chops it to covers.
Just a single, another good over in process. Just three of it till now. Powell again uses his feet and eases it down to long on for a run.
Uses his feet but Shakib shortens the length. Powell finds the fielder at mid-wicket with his flick.
Slower through the air on middle, Hope tries to defend but it goes off the inner half towards square leg for a run.
Full on the pads, Powell goes for the sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards short fine leg for a leg bye.
struggling to find the gaps here are the Windies batsmen. Once again Powell cuts it but finds the man at point.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. Another lovely over by Hasan. 4 and a wicket from it.
Powell works it through mid-wicket with the angle to get off the mark.
Kieran Powell strides out to the middle.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Hetmyer has been done in by the length there. Excellent by Mehidy. He fires this on the stumps, Hetmyer goes back and tries to pull but the ball is a little too full to play that. He misses it as the ball sneaks through and shatters the stumps behind. A big wicket for Bangladesh as the man in form is walking back after getting a start. Windies in trouble here, they need another 130 from 86.
Fires it on off, Hope defends it towards covers for a run.
Flatter outside off, SH cuts it through point and takes a run.
On the pads, Hope tries to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards short fine leg for a leg bye.
Quicker on the stumps, Hetmyer pushes it to covers. 6 from the over, a good one for Bangladesh according to the context of the game.
Smart batting, now Hope drives this through covers and takes a run. They need to keep doing this, find a boundary in every over and then nudge the rest for a run.

FOUR! A much-needed one and it has come from the bat of the person who was dropped. A poor ball by Shakib, short and on middle, Hope goes onto the back foot and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
The arm ball on middle, Hope pushes it back to the bowler.
On the pads, Hetmyer works it through square leg for a run.
Fires it on the stumps, Hetmyer guides it to point.
Drinks!
Eases this through covers for a run.
A low full toss on off, Hope opens the face of the bat and tries to drive it square on the off side. He finds the fielder at point. A single results.

OVERTHROWS! Windies will want many more bonus runs. This is quicker and on off, Hope taps it towards covers and goes for a run. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. There is no one backing up and hence an overthrow results.
Tries to pull but does not connect. It goes off the inner half towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Hope is happy to work it around the corner and get to the other end.
On the shorter side, Hetmyer punches it down to long off for a run.
Pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Sweeps it hard but once again can't find the gap towards deep square leg. Only a brace. This also brings up the 50-run stand between the two. They now need to step on the accelerator.
Pulls it but finds the man at short fine leg.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Flatter on off, SH punches it to covers.
Plays the sweep shot but finds the fielder. A dot to end another tight over.

In the air... dropped! Rubel is the culprit. He drops a relatively simple chance. Hope tries to go big, he had to there but does not connect properly. There is more height than distance as it goes towards wide long off. Rubel there runs to his left, tries to take it with both hands but drops it. The batsmen take two. The drop probably could prove to be a blessing in disguise for Bangladesh as Hope is struggling out there.
Shorter in length on off, SH cuts it through point for a run.
Hope this time works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end. 150 up for the Windies. They need another 152.
Two dots in a row! Hope tries to caress it through the covers but finds the fielder.
Flatter on off, Hope pushes it to covers. A dot.
A false start by the offie. Down the leg side, the keeper fails to collect it cleanly and the batsmen take a run. Also a wide is signaled.
Mehidy Hasan is back on.
Another single to end the over! Singles is something which won't hurt Bangladesh. Shakib once again attacks the stumps, Hetmyer eases it down to long on for a run.
Tries to sweep it fine but finds the fielder at 45.
This time Hope works it with the angle through the leg side and the batsmen cross.
Tucks it with the turn around the corner for a run.
Flatter on middle, Hetmyer goes for a sweep but the ball hits his glove, then onto his helmet and onto the ground.
Uses his feet and hits it past short mid off and down to long off for a run.
Comes in from over the wicket and angles this across the batsman. Hetmyer swings but makes connection with thin air.
Short and wide outside off, Hope cuts it towards backward point. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Stays in his crease and defends it off his back foot.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! Another similar ball outside off, Hope hangs back and finds the gap through covers for a boundary. A much needed one for the hosts.
Back of a length ball outside off, punched to the off side for one.
Quicker one on off, Hope gets an inside edge far away from the leg stump trying to drive it.
Gives this air on off, Hope drives it superbly but straight to the fielder.
Loopy ball down leg, Hetmyer flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Tucks this around the corner for one. That's 3 runs from 3 balls.
Takes a step ahead and works it down the leg side. Another run added.
Short ball outside off, punched off the back foot through cover-point for one.
Defended off the front foot by Shimron presenting the full face of the bat. Windies need 169 more.
Hetmyer defends it from within the crease.
Cutter outside off, Hetmyer looks to cut it but cannot make contact. The players appeal but the umpire is not interested.
FOUR! The old fashioned french-cut and Hetmyer gets a boundary for it. Goes to punch it to the off side but the ball gets a healthy inside edge past the leg pole. The ball races away to the fence.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside. One run added to the total.
Back of a length ball around off, given back to the bowler off the inner half.
Fuller one in line of the stumps, whipped for the fielder at mid-wicket to collect.
Tosses this one of the leg side, Hope flicks it to the short fine leg fielder. They take the run as it comes off his pads. Leg bye.
Leans ahead and drives but straight to the man at extra covers.
Takes the pace off this one and lands it outside off, Hope gets it off the inner half back to the bowler trying to drive it.
Bowls this full on the pads of Hetmyer who flicks it to the on side for another run.
Tossed up ball on middle, driven through mid off for an easy run.
Well, he did not there as he rocks back and guides it through point for a brace.

Fuller this time outside off, the batsman goes for a drive through the off side but misses. This is what they should be bowling to him. He is more of a leg side player and he seems to struggle a little to play through the off side.
FOUR! Top shot! This should get him going! Slightly short on middle, Hetmyer picks the length up early and pulls it over mid-wicket. The ball races away.
Fuller on off, Hetmyer swings but it goes off the inner half through square leg for a couple.
Good length again on middle, SH blocks it towards covers.
Hits the length hard on off, Hetmyer defends it towards mid off.
Tucked away to the on side for nothing. A good over for Shakib besides that boundary. 185 more needed.
Loopy ball on off, driven to cover-point.
FOUR! Great shot from Hope. Moves to the 20s now. Fetches this ball from outside off and swips this through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, hope leans ahead and drives it to the fielder at covers.
Slower one outside off, driven to the off side.
Flatter one around off, played back to the bowler.
Works this fuller ball to square leg for one.
Full on leg, Hope misses his flick and gets on his pads down the leg side.
Another one that keeps low. Clearly showing the nature of the pitch. Length ball outside off, Hope looks to pull it but the ball goes under his bat.
Played to the point region by Shai.
FOUR! First boundary for Hope in 34 balls and it's a good one. Stays in the crease and punches it on the up through the gap through cover-point for a good looking boundary.
Back of a length ball outside off, Hetmyer hits it towards mid off and hares to complete the run.
The arm ball on the pads, Hope tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
On the shorter side, Hetmyer does the right thing by playing it with a straight bat. He punches it down to long on for a run.
Floated it up on off, SH defends it.

Almost! Closer and flatter to the off pole. Hetmyer goes back to cut but it is the wrong shot to play. I will tell you. First, the ball is too close to play it and second, it is on a fuller length. Hetmyer misses his shot and luckily for him, the ball goes agonizingly past the off pole.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A loud shot but the umpire is not interested. Shakib tosses this up on leg stump, SH goes for the sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Shakib Al Hasan comes back into the attack. An expected change.
Cuts this towards backward point for one. End of a good over for the visitors. They pick the important wicket and give just 2 runs away.
Shimron Hetmyer walks out next.

OUT! Has this shot come out of frustration? Only Gayle will know and he misses out on a hundred. Rubel takes the pace off the ball and serves it full on middle and leg. Gayle looks to clear the long on fielder but finds Mehidy stationed there. He moves to his right and takes a good catch. He then throws the ball in the air in delight and Bangladesh are ecstatic. They know the importance of this wicket as Gayle was looking really good out there. More 196 runs needed for the hosts.
Slower ball outside off, Gayle fetches for it but cannot put bat to ball.
Fuller this time around off, driven to mid off. The runs have suddenly stopped for the home side.
Stays in the crease and defends it off his back foot.
Carves this through cover-point to get to the other end.
Good thinking from the bowler. Gayle was standing out of his crease. Seeing that Rahman bangs it short. Gayle can only duck under it.
Length ball on that fourth stump channel, Gayle drives it to mid off.
Back of a length ball outside off, Gayle square cuts this to point and yells 'NOOOO'.
Stays back and taps it to backward point. Dot ball. Windies need 198 runs.
Defended off the back foot by SH.
Full down the pads, flicked away to the on side for an easy run. 50 partnership up for these two.
Rolls his fingers to this and pitches it outside off, Hope gets low and plays it with soft hands to the off side. He thinks of the run but he is denied by his partner. The partnership is worth 49.
Good length ball around the off pole. Hope hangs back and punches it to mid off.
Opens the bat face and helps it to third man. The batsmen cross.
Another cutter outside off, Gayle is pleased to drive it back to the bowler.
Slower one outside off, defended with a straight bat.
Cutter outside off, Gayle pokes at it and can't make contact. The keeper takes it on the bounce.
Rubel Hossain to bowl his first over.
Lands this on middle and leg, Hope opens the bat face to the backward point region.
Full again this time strays it on the pads, Gayle flicks it away to the square leg region for s single.
Fuller one in line of the stumps, played back to the bowler.
Length outside off, cut to the backward point region.
This time Gayle plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Shai opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They cross.
Hope has driven it through mid on. One more run added to the total. Good come back from the bowler after going for 2 sixes in his first 2 balls. 14 from it though.
Play and miss! Hope looks to play against the turn and cannot put bat to ball.
Ohh!!! That kept really low. Off spinner on middle and leg, Gayle dopes well to get bat on ball to hit it to the on side. One run added to the total.
Quicker one outside off, Gayle is happy to leave it alone.
SIX! You don't bowl there either. Overpitches this on middle, Gayle gets under it and smokes it over the bowler's head for back-to-back maximums. New ball please.
SIX! SHOT! You don't bowl there to Chris Gayle! Short ball down leg. Gayle rocks back and pulls this over mid-wicket for a huge hit.
Excellent over from Rahman. Just one from it. Bowls a length ball in line of the stumps, Hope is happy to block it.
Good length this from the Fizz. Another back of a length ball on middle and leg, Hope hits it back towards the bowler.
Similar ball, Hope hops a tad and bunts it down.
Back of a length ball around off, punched to mid off for a quick run.
Fuller this time on the pads, Gayle gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Length ball down leg, Gayle turns his bat to the on side and blocks it.
Drinks break! Windies need 220 runs in 204 balls at 6.47 rpo.
And now rotates the strike. A lot of maturity in today's Gayle. Punches this off the back foot towards mid off to retain the strike.
FOUR! Gayle is getting easy runs here. Wrong line down leg, he flicks it off his pad towards the fine leg region. Boundary.
Hangs on the back foot and pushes the ball to the off side for a run.
Straighter one on middle, Hope defends by presenting a full bat.
Shai rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
In line of the stumps, keeps low, Hope does well to get bat to ball.
Mahmudullah is introduced into the attack.
OHHH! Once again a delivery misbehaving and causing problems for the batsman. On the leg stump, stays low a touch. Gayle tries to defend but misses too get hit on the pads.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Back of a length on off, Hope punches the ball off the back foot through covers for a run.

Fifty for Gayle but that was brilliantly bowled by Mustafizur. Bowls the slower one on middle, Gayle is completely foxed as he tries to keep it out. It goes off the inner half towards square leg and the batsmen take a run. He gets to the other end and raises his bat and soaks in the applause. He would now want to make it big and he knows if he does, Windies will take the series.
Length ball again on off, Gayle guides it to point.
Back of a length on off, Gayle defends it.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.

SIX!  Straight as an arrow and with a lot of power! Tosses this up on middle, once again a little too full. Just where Gayle likes it. He hits it flat over the bowler and it has carried all the way. 229 more needed.
Goes back and clips it through mid-wicket with the turn for a run.
On the shorter side, Gayle eases it down to long off for a run.
Flatter on middle, Hope punches it down to long on for a run.
A full toss on off, Hope drives it to covers.
Mosaddek Hossain is into the attack.
Another back of a length ball on off, Gayle guides it to point. Just a single of the Fiz's first.
Back of a length on off, Gayle stands tall and defends.
Nicely played but only a run. On the shorter side, Hope half pulls it through square leg for a run.
On the shorter side outside off, going away with the angle further. Hope tries to cut but gets beaten.
Back of a length on off, Hope tries to whip it through mid-wicket but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
On a length outside off, Hope makes a leave.
Mustafizur Rahman is into the attack.
Slower one in line of the stumps, Hope goes back and hits it towards mid-wicket.
Smart from Gayle. Taps this around the corner to rotate strike.
Similar ball on off, Hope leans ahead and drives it to mid on to change ends.
Tossed up outside off, driven back towards the bowler.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Flatter one on the pads, flicked away to the square leg fielder.
FOUR! Poor ball to end a successful over! Down the leg side, Gayle nudges it fine down the leg side and the ball races away.
On a length again on off, this one comes back in after pitching. The batsman tries to defend but it goes off the inner half towards square leg for a run.
Good length on off, Gayle taps it towards cover and gets to the other end.
Another lovely delivery! On a length around off, this one pitches and then straightens. Gayle pokes at it and gets beaten.
On the middle stump, Hope tucks it around the corner and gets to the other end.
Shai Hope is the new man in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Lewis is walking back and who has got him? Any guesses? Mashrafe Mortaza is the man once again. Three out of three times in this series. This one is a beauty. On a length around off, coming in with the angle which means the batsman has to play at it. The ball pitches, zips off the surface and also bounces a touch more. Lewis pokes at it and the ball takes the edge and flies towards Rahim. The keeper jumps and takes it. A much-needed breakthrough for Bangladesh and they would now look to bring things under control.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring.
Yes he can! Only a single as Lewis eases it to long off.
Flatter on off, Lewis off the back foot punches it to covers. It has been a good over till now, can he finish it well?
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Quicker on off, Lewis pushes it to covers.
Full on off, Lewis tries to drive but it goes off the inner half towards square leg.
Down the leg side but the batsman misses the sweep and it is wided.
Floats it up on off, kept out.
SIX! Stand and deliver! Back of a length ball outside off, Gayle makes room and just flat-bats this over extra cover for a biggie. Pure power on that.
Defended off the back foot by CG.
Wide. The batsman tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. The umpire has signalled a wide.
FOUR! Easy runs this! Slow ball down leg, Gayle just helps it on its way. No fine leg there and Gayle will get four for it.

Not Out! Lewis is in and they even take the overthrow. Back of a length ball outside off, Lewis cuts it towards backward point. He comes a step ahead but is sent back by Gayle. The fielder there hits his target but Lewis seems to be in. The ball ricochets towards deep square leg and the batsmen run an overthrow. The umpire waits for the run to get completed and then just wants to have a look if his bat is in or not. He goes upstairs and replays confirm Lewis is safe.
A run out appeal is taken up. The batsman looks to be well in.
Swing and miss! Length ball on leg, Lewis makes room and looks to heave this to the on side. Only manages to make contact with thin air.
Fuller in length around off, driven to covers.
Flatter on off, Gayle defends it.

NOT OUT! Missing! Excellent decision by the umpire. Bangladesh lose their only review. He bowls this quicker on middle, Gayle shuffles across and tries to flick but misses. There is a loud appeal which follows but the umpire shakes his head. Mehidy is very confident and he convinces his captain to go for the review. He does so. Time for the replays and it shows no bat involved. Also the leg stump is visible as it struck Gayle on his pads. But the ball is going down leg stump with the angle. The on-field call stays.
Review time! Bangladesh feel they have Gayle trapped in front. They have gone for the review and look very confident.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
BEAUTY! Hasan floats this up on off, this one drifts into the batsman, pitches and then straightens. Gayle plays inside the line and gets beaten.

FOUR! A blemish in the field! Not good this by Bangladesh. Mehidy is certainly not happy. This is bowled on the stumps, Gayle tries to go downtown but the ball takes the inner half and goes towards square leg. Mosaddek Hossain there misfields and the ball races away.
Bowls it on off, Gayle defends it.
Fuller in length on off, Lewis drives it to covers,
Just behind a length on off, Lewis pulls but finds mid-wicket. Both the left handers now looking to score.
Another quick single! On a length around middle, Gayle opens his body to smash it but since there is no width offered, he defends it towards covers and gets to the other end.
Back of a length on middle, Gayle nudges it to mid-wicket.
On the shorter side, Lewis swings but it goes off the inner half towards square leg for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

FOUR! STREAKY! Gayle though will take it. A maximum and a boundary to end the over. Full outside off this time. Gayle swings but the ball takes the outside edge, goes over the fielder at first slip and into the fence.

SIX! BOOM! Hasan this time bowls it a little too full and he pays the price. Gayle lofts it easily over the bowler's head and the ball carries all the way. He is now gone past Jayasuriya in the six hitting list.
Nudges it with the angle through mid-wicket and takes a run.
Very full on off, driven back to the bowler.
WIDE! Fires this down the leg side, Lewis tries to pull but misses.
Tosses it up on off, Lewis drives it to the man at covers.
Down the leg side, Lewis tries to sweep but misses. A wide signaled.
Quicker on off, Lewis off the back foot defends it.
Gayle again makes room and slaps it but finds the fielder at covers.
A little too short on off, coming in with the angle. Lewis tries to pull but gets it off the inner half towards deep square leg for a run.
FOUR! Too easy! Very full and on the leg stump, Lewis loves it there. He hits it hard through mid on and the ball races away. His first boundary.
On a length around off, Lewis blocks it.
The off cutter on the pads, Gayle tucks it around the corner for a run.
Fuller in length on middle, Lewis drives it towards wide mid on for a run.

Good delivery to end the over! Flighted ball outside off, this one pitches and straightens. Gayle does not account for the turn as he tries to defend. He gets beaten, End of another good over by Hasan.
Down the leg side, Lewis misses out on his flick shot. The ball brushes his pads and goes towards short fine leg for a leg bye.
Could have been 4 but Hasan misfields. Releases all the pressure he had built. Flatter and on the shorter side. Gayle punches it back towards the bowler. He fumbles and a single is taken.
On the stumps, Gayle drives it back to the bowler. 3 dots in a row.
Slower through the air on off, Gayle tries to hit it through the off side but gets it off the inner half towards the bowler.
Quicker on off, Gayle shuffles across and defends it.
A single to end the over! On a length around middle, Gayle punches it down towards mid on for a run. 8 runs from this over, a good one for Windies.
1000 runs for Evin Lewis in ODIs. The 35th Windies player to reach this mark. He  cuts this hard towards point where the fielder dives and makes a half stop. Can't stop the single though.
Once again moves his front leg out of the way but Mashrafe bowls it closer to his body. Gayle times it towards mid off for a run.
FOUR! Slapped! Gayle was expecting a length ball there and he got one. He backs away and hits it through covers for the first boundary of the innings.
Shortens his length this time and bowls it on middle, Lewis shuffles inside and tucks it around the corner for a run.
Goes fuller again on middle, no swing on offer. Lewis strokes it back towards the bowler.

An appeal to end the over! Fires this on the pads, Gayle fails to defend and gets pinged on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Going down leg. Another good over comes to an end. However, we did not see Mehidy getting a lot of purchase.
Works this through mid-wicket with the angle and gets off the mark.
Darts it on off, Lewis goes back and punches it to covers.
Fires it on off, Gayle strokes it down to long off for a run.
Gayle uses his feet and seeing that Mehidy shortens his length. Chris blocks it.
Flatter and quicker on off, Gayle lunges forward and keeps it out.
Mehidy Hasan will bowl with the second new ball.

A good finish for Lewis. He finally times one. Mashrafe bowls this a touch fuller outside off, Evin leans ahead and strokes it off the middle but finds the fielder at covers. A good first over by the visitors' skipper comes to an end.

This one stays low! Signs of the pitch becoming a lot tougher to bat? Well we surely did not see this when the Windies were bowling. Mashrafe lands it on a length outside off, Lewis tries to keep it out but is beaten by the low bounce.
Lovely length once again. Outside off, Evin makes another leave.
Extra bounce and that has been nicely played! On a length around off, this one takes off after pitching. Lewis does well to play it with soft hands as the ball hits the top portion of the bat.
Straightaway comes around the wicket to Lewis and lands it on a length outside off, it has been left alone.

Windies are underway and once again, like we have seen throughout this series, Gayle goes for a quick run and makes it. He drops this length ball in front of the fielder at covers and takes a quick single.

We are back for the chase! Chris Gayle and Evin Lewis will open the batting for the Windies. The former will be on strike and he will face Mashrafe Mortaza who will bowl with the first new ball. Here we go...
